description: Resource Type definition for AWS::StorageGateway::NFSFileShare. An NFS file share exposes an Amazon S3 bucket through a Storage Gateway file gateway, so clients read and write objects as files over NFS. The share's variant is fixed by its resource type rather than by a property: the service constructs the two variants with different APIs, and a property carrying the choice would belong to neither API's input.

NFSFileShareDefaults.description: Default values for the file and directory permissions of an NFS share. Removing this property from a template leaves the live values unchanged rather than clearing them, because the service has no reset for it: a create that omits the object leaves it absent, but the update path merges member by member keyed on the same internal sentinel that reports absence, so no request can restore that state. Set the members you want rather than relying on removal.
